name: party-flight-chess
description: 仓库级任务入口（不含依赖）：提交前跑一次 npm run verify

scripts.verify: npm run verify:kernel && npm run verify:client && npm run verify:server
scripts.verify:kernel: npm --prefix kernel run typecheck && npm --prefix kernel test
scripts.verify:client: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix client test
scripts.verify:server: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix server test
scripts.test: npm --prefix kernel test && npm --prefix client test && npm --prefix server test
